target_name: Liquid and freshly built firms raising capital
rationale: This is a mechanical blend of two conditioners already tested individually against the identical net-financing leg (gen-2 cash/assets, gen-7 net-to-gross plant), so it is a weighting variant of existing archive entries rather than a new mechanism, and averaging two conditioners of similar strength will most likely produce a slope and alpha bracketed by the parents.

The two conditioners are the cross-sectional and time-series versions of the *same* variable (che/at), so the claim that they "carry substantially different information" is unsupported — they are near-certainly highly correlated — and the proposal is the most cosmetic recombination in the batch, re-pairing two archived signals that already share an identical financing leg.

target_name: Gross intake by freshly built firms
rationale: The 2×2 swap of an archived financing leg (gross intake, gen-7) onto an archived conditioner (asset vintage, gen-7) is a defensible pairing and the gross-versus-net distinction is economically real, but it is still a component recombination inside a saturated family rather than a new economic channel, and the expected result is interpolation between two already-known outcomes.

This is the first conditioner in the archive based on the *direction of change* in the capital stock rather than a level, the sign logic is internally consistent (contracting firms raising money score high and are predicted to underperform), and it tests a genuinely different story — financing decline/distress rather than opportunism by comfortable firms — though it partly overlaps the well-known asset-growth and net-external-financing anomalies and the long tail (shrinking firms retiring securities) is close to a standard low-growth/payout portfolio.

target_name: Serial overpayers returning to the market
rationale: Conditioning on the *stock* of goodwill as a record of past acquisitiveness is a distinct, predetermined dimension not previously used as a weight (the gen-0 goodwill signal used the annual change as a co-ranked leg), and the structure is internally consistent; the main risk is that goodwill/assets largely proxies for intangible intensity and size, so the reweighting may add little beyond the plain net-financing leg.

target_name: Raise measured against the existing war chest
rationale: This is a denominator swap on an already-tested signal, and the stated defense is wrong on the mechanics — WINSOR and IND_ZSCORE are computed cross-sectionally over all firms, including the cash-poor ones whose tiny denominators generate the explosive values, so the standardization is contaminated *before* the liquidity weight suppresses those names.
